notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40819806/23823e1aded04d2a6d16c0e758eb3a3315c68e4f.gif[/img]


[h2][b]We're happy to announce a new addition![/b][/h2]

We've added endless game mode with a leaderboard and new weapon.
In it, you can build turrets and traps.
The enemies will drop loot in the form of ammunition and resources that you can use to buy weapons and turrets by pressing Tab.
Every 10 waves, the game will autosave, and you don't have to start all over again if you lose.
Game results are shown on the leaderboard.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40819806/205a345436e71cd13361c0b0b575f7dd44b107b7.gif[/img]

 

[h3][b]We also updated the main game by:[/b][/h3]
[list]

[*] Adding the headshot effect.

[*] Replacing weapon icons.

[*] Fixing the blur effect that was left after returning from a parallel dimension.

[*] Accelerating the time of appearance of enemies' compass by 15 seconds.

[*] Fixing game crashes when opening menus.

[*] Adding a blur effect when opening a menu.

[*] Improving some interface elements.

[*] Changing the intelligence of some enemies.

[*] Improving swordplay.

[*] Adding crashing objects.

[*] Changing some sets of enemies on levels.

[*] Fixing many minor bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[b]We're happy to announce to you the first update of the game![/b]

[b]The player's death mechanic was redone:[/b]
Now you don't have to start from the beginning after game over. You'll have a chance to be reborn.
As starting everything from scratch can be disappointing, We’ve decided to make death mechanic a gameplay element with a chance to be reborn.

After death your characters will leave their body to the parallel universe, where they’ll have to manage to collect life energy. Each piece of energy brings 10% hitpoints. Within time your characters will be reborn with the hitpoints earned.

In the parallel universe the amount of life energy is limited, so don’t pick up every piece of it at once, otherwise your characters will die without the opportunity of being reborn.
At easy difficulty level your characters will always be reborn even if you haven’t collected any life energy.


[b]Some more updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Melee damage increased
[*] Melee damage effects and sounds added
[*] Sword damage increased
[*] Movement keys were added to the settings menu
[/list]
